name: Czechia
dossier:
The Czechia national football team, affectionately known to their passionate supporters as the Národní tým, enter the FIFA World Cup 2026 with high expectations. Currently ranked number 40 in the world, they bring a unique tactical identity and style from UEFA to this expanded 48-team tournament.

Heirs to a proud Central European footballing tradition, hunting their first deep run as Czechia.

With the tournament co-hosted across the United States, Mexico, and Canada, Czechia will count on their travelling support to create a vibrant atmosphere. Their primary objective will be to make a statement in Group A and navigate their way to the high-stakes knockout rounds.
whatToWatch: Keep a close eye on their transition play in Group A. The connection between Patrik Schick and Tomáš Souček is crucial to their attacking spark.
xFactor: Patrik Schick - the clinical striker who holds the ability to turn a match on its head with a single moment of magic.
verdict: Czechia are poised to be one of the most intriguing stories of the group stage, bringing great energy to the tournament.
funFacts: Patrik Schick once scored from inside his own half at the Euros  -  Czechia always carry a moment of magic.
Czechia boast 0 World Cup titles in their historical cabinet, with their best tournament finish being Runners-up as Czechoslovakia (1934, 1962).
